subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The study of Man
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anthropology"** refers to the study of human societies, cultures, and their development. (मनुष्य जाति का अध्ययन)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to major in **anthropology** to learn more about different cultures and their histories.
 
 
 
• **"Autobiography" **is a self-written account of the life of oneself. (आत्मकथा)
 
 
• **Example: **Nelson Mandela's **autobiography** provides deep insights into his life and struggles.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the study of Man is correctly termed as **"Anthropology"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Autobiography** (आत्मकथा): A self-written account of the life of oneself.

 
 
• **Example:** Mahatma Gandhi's **autobiography "The Story of My Experiments with Truth"** is well-known worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Biography** (जीवनी): A detailed description of a person's life written by someone else.
 
 
• **Example:** The **biography** of Steve Jobs by Walter Isaacson is a bestseller.
 
 
 
• **Biology** (जीवविज्ञान): The scientific study of life and living organisms.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a keen interest in** biology** and wants to become a biologist.

The correct answer is **Option 3)**<
